title: Street poster sequence

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Let adjacent panels share a message so viewers can connect signature, claim and product while moving past.
strategic_value: A sequence of logo, ingredient language and close-up food can reinforce Burger King through several short encounters.
demonstration: Street hoarding places food photography, the primary logo, Freshly Sliced with tomatoes, and a macro burger image side by side.
practical_value: Compare how each panel contributes a distinct role to a larger campaign sequence.

content_islands.name: Food and signature
content_islands.spec: Place the food scene and cream logo panel at left.

content_islands.name: Ingredient claim
content_islands.spec: Use a brown panel with red tomatoes and cream Freshly Sliced lettering in the middle.

content_islands.name: Product close-up
content_islands.spec: Finish with a large burger crop at right, preserving the pavement setting.

reference_purposes.Application: The multi-panel street installation combines photography, logo, illustration and wording in one campaign sequence.
